designSummary: Cross-sectional survey with non-response weighting and an agreement analysis.
sampleSize: About 900 eligible attenders within six months of starting treatment and 65 percent response give about 585 respondents. A prevalence near 38 percent would have a 95 percent confidence interval of about plus or minus 3.9 percentage points, and a comparison between groups making up 40 and 60 percent of respondents has 80 percent power to detect a difference of about 11.5 percentage points. Kappa for the checkbox would be estimated within about plus or minus 0.08.
primaryAnalysis: Weighted prevalence of moderate or severe financial toxicity with 95 percent confidence intervals, overall and by group; prevalence ratios from a Poisson model with robust variance adjusted for the six group variables.
secondaryAnalysis: Proportion of affected patients identified by the checkbox with its confidence interval, and kappa; out-of-pocket spending by distance and therapy type.
missingData: Scored as the instrument manual directs for missing items; unit non-response weighted on age, sex, distance and months since starting treatment; respondents without a screening form within four weeks are excluded from the agreement analysis and counted.
multiplicity: One primary estimate; secondary estimates reported with confidence intervals.
overfittingGuards: Agreement threshold fixed by the instrument manual
summary: About 585 respondents; prevalence within about 3.9 points; 80 percent power for an 11.5-point difference between groups.
